title: 400,000 Sailors Got Stuck at Sea in 2020
asof: Rules from MLC 2006 · data as of 2025 · full video on the channel

shots.s: Imagine finishing your job, and not being allowed to go home.
Container ship crews usually sign on for six to nine months.
The rules say no more than eleven months on board without leave.
Then in 2020, COVID closed the borders.
Crews couldn't fly home, and replacements couldn't fly in.
By December 2020, the UN shipping agency said over four hundred thousand seafarers were stuck at sea.
Many were past the end of their contracts.
Calling home was all they had.
Could you stay on board an extra six months?
